fluff.overview: The Word of Blake Militia inherited ComStar's combined-arms organizational philosophy and its Star League-era equipment stocks, fielding infantry formations that ranked among the best equipped in the Inner Sphere during the Jihad. Foot infantry Level I formations provided the bulk of Protectorate garrison manpower, assigned to hold ground that the Militia's BattleMech forces had already taken. On occupied worlds, these platoons maintained checkpoints, patrolled population centers, and enforced curfews as the visible face of Blakist territorial control. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of ignited fuel, these troops carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry, effective at clearing fortified positions and enclosed spaces at the cost of extreme danger to the operator.
